longBusinessSummary: Silver Grant International Holdings Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property investment and securities trading businesses in the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Property Leasing, Investments, and New Energy Investment and Operation segments. It invests in and develops residential and commercial properties; and operation of distributed photovoltaic power generation stations and the energy storage business. The company is also involved in environmental conservation and renewable energy investment, non-performing asset investment, and trading activities; and provision of corporate management services. The company was formerly known as Silver Grant International Industries Limited and changed its name to Silver Grant International Holdings Group Limited in May 2019. Silver Grant International Holdings Group Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
